title: gRPC Interoperability & Release Matrix Configuration
description: Declarative configuration for cross-language gRPC interoperability tests, HTTP/2 negative suites, cloud-to-prod authentication suites, and historical backward-compatibility release matrix tests. HOW TO ADD A LANGUAGE: Add an entry under 'languages' with 'client_cmd' (and optional 'server_cmd'/'http2_client_cmd'), working directory ('cwd' or 'client_cwd'/'server_cwd'), and capability deltas ('add_client_capabilities'/'remove_client_capabilities', 'add_server_capabilities'/'remove_server_capabilities') relative to 'language_defaults'. HOW TO ADD A TEST CASE: Add an entry under 'test_cases.<suite>' with 'capabilities' (shared by client and server) or 'client_capabilities'/'server_capabilities' (when asymmetric). HOW TO ADD A MATRIX RELEASE: Append the git tag to 'matrix.languages.<lang>.releases' and only add an 'overrides' entry if non-default runtimes, patches, or legacy testcase profiles are required. SYNC RULE: tools/interop/config.schema.json and tools/interop/config.json MUST be kept strictly in sync at all times (enforced by tools/interop/runner.py and tools/interop/test_interop.py).

$schema.description: Relative path or URI to the JSON Schema validating this configuration file.

capabilities.description: Canonical list of all positive feature, credential, and transport capabilities recognized by the gRPC interop harness.

prod_servers.description: Mapping of logical production server nicknames (e.g. default, gateway_v4) to their target hostnames.

^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$.description: Fully-qualified hostname of the production interop server.

prod_server_capabilities.description: Capabilities supported by production gRPC interop servers.

languages.description: Per-language endpoint definitions. Each language inherits from language_defaults and states only its commands, working directories, environment variables, and capability overrides.

capability.description: Positive feature, credential, or transport capability token.

transport_security_mode.description: Transport security or custom credentials mode for interop test execution.

command_object.description: Structured command invocation specification for non-append argument modes.

args_mode.description: How interop CLI flags are passed to the command.

arg_template.description: Format string template for joined_flag or extract_port_template modes.

port_regex.description: Regular expression used to extract the server port in extract_port_template mode.

command_spec.description: Command invocation specification: a single executable string (append mode), a simple argv token list (append mode), or a structured command_object.

oneOf.description: Single executable command string where runtime interop flags are appended directly.
Argv token list where runtime interop flags are appended directly.

test_cases.description: Unified test case registry grouped by suite (standard, auth, http2_client, http2_server).

standard.description: Standard gRPC client/server interoperability test cases.

auth.description: Cloud-to-prod authentication and credentials interoperability test cases.

http2_server.description: HTTP/2 negative and framing server test cases.

standard_test_case.description: Standard gRPC client/server interoperability test case definition.

capabilities.description: Capabilities required by both client and server to run this test case.

extra_cloud_to_cloud_flags.description: Extra CLI flags appended when running this test case in cloud_to_cloud mode.

auth_test_case.description: Cloud-to-prod authentication and credentials interoperability test case definition.

capabilities.description: Capabilities required by both client and server to run this auth test case.

transport_security.description: Transport or custom credentials security mode (defaults to tls when omitted).

requires_compute_engine_creds.description: Whether this test case unconditionally requires GCE metadata credentials.

uses_service_account_key.description: Whether this test case requires a service account key file.

uses_service_account_key_when_flag.description: CLI flag name that enables passing the service account key file via environment.

uses_oauth_scope.description: Whether this test case passes --oauth_scope to the client.

uses_default_service_account.description: Whether this test case passes --default_service_account to the client.

requires_compute_engine_creds_capability.description: Client capability indicating that GCE credentials are required for this test case.

uses_default_service_account_capability.description: Client capability indicating that --default_service_account should be passed.

http2_client_test_case.description: HTTP/2 client edge-case test case definition.

capabilities.description: Capabilities required by both client and server for this HTTP/2 test case.

http2_server_test_case.description: HTTP/2 negative and framing server test case definition with asymmetric client/server capabilities.

client_capabilities.description: Capabilities required by the client for this HTTP/2 server test case.

server_capabilities.description: Capabilities required by the server for this HTTP/2 server test case.

grpc_client_test_case.description: Underlying standard gRPC client test case name when driven by a standard gRPC client.

language_defaults.description: Default configuration inherited by every language entry under languages.

repo.description: Default repository identifier for gRPC implementations.

included_in_all_clients.description: Whether the language is included when -l all is specified on the CLI.

supports_server.description: Whether the language provides a cloud-to-cloud interop server by default.

docker_supported.description: Whether the language runs inside a Docker container under --use_docker.

is_http2_target.description: Whether the entry represents the dedicated HTTP/2 interop test client/server pair.

client_capabilities.description: Default client capability baseline inherited by languages unless overridden.

server_capabilities.description: Default server capability baseline inherited by languages unless overridden.

language_entry.description: Language or endpoint configuration overriding language_defaults.

safename.description: Filesystem and Docker image safe identifier (defaults to the language key name).

repo.description: Repository identifier when different from language_defaults.repo.

included_in_all_clients.description: Override whether the language is included in -l all.

supports_server.description: Override whether the language supports running as an interop server.

docker_supported.description: Override whether the language supports Docker execution.

is_http2_target.description: Whether this entry defines the dedicated HTTP/2 client and server harness.

cwd.description: Shared working directory for both client_cwd and server_cwd relative to the container workdir root.

client_cwd.description: Working directory for the interop client relative to the container workdir root.

server_cwd.description: Working directory for the interop server relative to the container workdir root.

http2_cwd.description: Working directory for the negative HTTP/2 client relative to the container workdir root.

global_env.description: Environment variables set for all invocations of this language.

cloud_to_prod_env.description: Additional environment variables set for cloud_to_prod invocations.

client_cmd.description: Command specification for running the interop client.

server_cmd.description: Command specification for running the interop server.

http2_client_cmd.description: Command specification for running the negative HTTP/2 interop client.

http2_server_client_capabilities.description: Client capabilities exposed when the HTTP/2 target is instantiated in the server role.

http2_client_server_capabilities.description: Server capabilities exposed when the HTTP/2 target is instantiated in the client role.

matrix.description: Historical gRPC release backward-compatibility matrix configuration.

servers.description: Target production server hostnames tested by each matrix release.

test_cases.description: Standard interop test cases executed against each matrix server.

languages.description: Per-language release lists and release-range overrides for the compatibility matrix.

testcase_profiles.description: Named historical client command profiles referenced by matrix releases.

matrix_language.description: Matrix release catalog and optional per-release/range overrides for a language.

repo.description: Git repository URL to clone when building historical release images (defaults to https://github.com/grpc/grpc.git).

runtimes.description: Default Docker runtime image variants for this language (defaults to [lang]).

build_from_release_tag.description: Whether build_interop_image.sh is invoked from the checked-out release tag (defaults to true).

root_env_var.description: Environment variable pointing to the checked-out repository root (defaults to GRPC_ROOT).

releases.description: Ordered list of historical git release tags tested in the backward-compatibility matrix.

overrides.description: Release-specific overrides keyed by tag, inclusive range (start..end), or comma-separated tags/ranges.

matrix_release_override.description: Overrides applied to matching historical releases in the matrix.

patch.description: Repository-relative file paths staged after applying tools/interop_matrix/patches/<lang>_<release>/git_repo.patch.

runtimes.description: Runtime image variants overriding the language default runtimes for these releases.

testcases_file.description: Matrix testcase profile name in matrix.testcase_profiles overriding <lang>__master.

matrix_testcase_profile.description: Historical client command profile used to generate docker run invocations for matrix tests.

cmd.description: Client command prefix executed inside the container before interop flags.

workdir.description: Container working directory (defaults to /var/local/git/grpc when omitted).

host_override.description: Whether to include --server_host_override={server_host} and legacy flag ordering.

joined_flag.description: Whether interop flags are passed inside a single --args=\"...\" argument.

env.description: Container environment variables passed via docker run -e.

bash_login.description: Whether to invoke bash -l -c instead of bash -c.
